name: dispatch
description: Cross-agent dispatch with explicit model and reasoning effort selection, task handoff, result verification and a zero-dependency lane board, plus an orchestrator skill for running many lanes at once

interface.shortDescription: Choose and brief subagents, then verify their work.
interface.longDescription: Select a worker model and reasoning effort, hand off work to subagents or model CLIs, verify artifacts, and track automatic or manual lanes on a read-only board. The orchestrator skill covers running many lanes at once: keeping lanes full, cross-model review, what to ask the user, and closing lanes cleanly.
defaultPrompt: Use $dispatch to plan and delegate this work to subagents.
Use $dispatch to get an independent review from another model.
Use $orchestrator to keep several agent lanes moving and track them on a board.
